chunks: Abu Al-Abbas Al-Kufi, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Ali ibn Rashid, who said:

I asked him about the Fitra, for whom is it? He said: For the Imam. I said to him, 'So can I inform my companions?' He said: 'Yes, the ones whom you intend to purify from them.' And he said: 'There is no problem if you were to give, and convert the price of that as silver (cash).'

key_terms.الْفِطْرَة: Fitra (obligatory alms-tax paid on Eid al-Fitr)
key_terms.لِلْإِمَام: For the Imam (indicating ownership or entitlement)
key_terms.وَرِقاً: Silver (used here to denote cash/value equivalent)

ai.seo_question: Who is entitled to receive the Fitra and can it be paid in cash?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* clarifies the authority over Fitra, affirming it belongs to the Imam while granting individuals the discretion to distribute it to specific recipients they deem worthy of purification. It further introduces the juristic flexibility of paying Fitra in silver (cash equivalent) rather than solely in food, reflecting the practical needs of the community. This supports the Shia view of the Imam's exclusive right to collect and distribute Zakat, while allowing for adaptive application in daily practice.

en.hubeali: Abu Al Abbas Al Kufy, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Ali Bin Rashid who said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the Fitra, for whom is it?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the Imam<sup>asws</sup>’. I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘So can I inform my companions?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes, the ones whom you intend to purify from them’. And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem if you were to give, and convert the price of that as silver (cash)’.
en.sarwar: 23. Abu al-‘Abbas al-Kufiy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from abu Ali ibn Rashid who has said the following:

“I once asked him (the Imam) about al-Fitrah, ‘To whom does it belong?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It belongs to the Imam.’ I then asked, ‘Can I tell my people about it?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, if you like to cleanse certain ones among them.’ He (the Imam) then said, ‘It is not harmful to change the price of al-Fitrah in to wariq (cash).”’
